independentReview.reviewer: Codex query_evaluation and Codex cli_usability independent source reviewers
independentReview.disclosure: Reviewers are independent of corpus authorship and held-out outputs; they have Compass implementation knowledge. AI review, not human review. Acceptance concerns source identities/behavior/connectivity and the pre-output question rubric, not graph precision or complete occurrence multiplicity.
